title: Fourier expansion of the biased derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in(0,1)$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $i$ be one of the $n$ coordinates, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The biased discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ at $x$ equals the sum, over all subsets $S$ of the coordinates containing $i$, of the biased Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ times the biased monomial indexed by $S\setminus\{i\}$ evaluated at $x$.
